column1: # Conversions of the special values, see docs/spec/special_values.md. Not run by the tests yet.
# Columns: source type, source value, target type[start value], expected: the value of the target, or
# EXC:<class>,<value left in the target>. Values read as in conversion.tsv. A special source value is written
# @+Inf, @-Inf, @NaN or @-NaN (docs/spec/special_values.md, "Notation", says how a program gets each one). A
# decfloat target holding a special value reads +Infinity, -Infinity, NaN or -NaN; an f target reads as its bits.
